title: Design System: TNC · The Nuclear Club (radiasi.id)

title.purpose: Booking console and membership pass headers.

body.purpose: Section lead paragraphs and club descriptions (max 62ch).

label.purpose: Schedule rows, NTRP badges, slot counters, and IDR pricing.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Authoritative deceleration curve for tab switches, slot selection, and button states.

components.name: Primary Volt CTA Button
components.description: High-visibility Optic Tennis Volt pill button for slot booking and QRIS checkout.
components.css: .ds-btn-volt { height: 49px; padding: 0 28px; border: none; border-radius: 25px; background: #D1E432; color: #131F0F; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-volt:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-volt:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-volt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D1E432; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ledger Ghost Action Button
components.description: Outlined court-line button used inside weekly schedule ledger rows.
components.css: .ds-btn-ledger { padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1.5px solid #131F0F; background: transparent; color: #131F0F; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ledger:hover { background: #131F0F; color: #F0F2E6; } .ds-btn-ledger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D1E432; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selectable Session Capacity Card
components.description: Dark olive session selector displaying court name, remaining slots, and live volt capacity bar.
components.html: SENAYAN COURT 1 · 19:003 SLOTS LEFT
components.css: .ds-session-card { width: 360px; padding: 14px 18px; border: 1px solid #D1E432; border-radius: 10px; background: #162315; color: #F0F2E6; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-session-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-slots { color: #C7D938; } .ds-track { width: 100%; height: 11px; border-radius: 6px; background: #2C3927; overflow: hidden; } .ds-fill { width: 65%; height: 100%; border-radius: 6px; background: #D1E432; }

components.name: NTRP Skill Rating Pill
components.description: Compact olive badge indicating required player NTRP tier for a court session.
components.css: .ds-ntrp-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: #3D4F34; color: #F0F2E6; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Bunker Form Input
components.description: Dark court-bunker text field for tournament doubles pair registration.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 260px; background: #162315; border: 1px solid #3F4E3B; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; color: #F0F2E6; font-family: 'Quattrocento Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #C6D0B4; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D1E432; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
TNC (The Nuclear Club) merges the architectural precision of a championship tennis scoreboard with the warm, tactile permanence of a heritage court club. The interface splits into two deliberate zones: an editorial left field on warm chalk alabaster (#F3F3EB) governed by exposed 1.5px baseline rules (#596051), and an operational right-hand booking console housed in deep court bunker olive (#121E13). Every surface prioritizes scannable court schedules, live slot capacity meters, NTRP skill badges, and instant QR Court Pass verification.

Rather than relying on decorative SaaS cards, floating glass layers, or generic sports stock cliches, the system treats data rows like court boundary lines. Contrast between the warm chalk editorial canvas and the high-density dark bunker console gives the page an immediate sense of place, while Optic Tennis Volt (#D1E432) is reserved strictly for primary transaction triggers and live slot meters.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetric 7/5 desktop split pairing editorial club storytelling on warm chalk with an always-live dark bunker booking console.
Exposed 1px and 1.5px olive-tinted court boundary rules that structure navigation, stat strips, and weekly session ledgers without nested card boxes.
Single high-visibility accent (#D1E432 Optic Tennis Volt) restricted to primary CTAs, active capacity bars, and live tournament scores.
Tabular numeric discipline (tabular-nums) across all court times, slot counters, NTRP ratings, and IDR pricing.

rules.name: The Optic Volt Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Optic Tennis Volt (#D1E432) never appears as a section background or decorative graphic; it marks only actionable booking triggers and live slot availability.

rules.name: The Tinted Court Neutral Rule
rules.body: Pure black (#000000), pure white (#FFFFFF), and untinted grays are prohibited; every neutral carries a warm chalk or deep olive court undertone.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section headings stand directly on their own authority (<h2>) without small uppercase eyebrow labels or category kickers stacked above them.

rules.name: The Tabular Scoreboard Rule
rules.body: Every element displaying time (19:00 WIB), remaining slots (3 / 12 SLOTS LEFT), NTRP ratings (3.5), or currency (IDR 125.000) enforces font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Court-Line Separation Rule
rules.body: Never wrap list rows or schedule items inside individual shadowed cards; separate sibling records with exposed 1px horizontal boundary rules.

dos: Do pair Warm Chalk Alabaster (#F3F3EB) editorial sections with Deep Court Bunker (#121E13) operational consoles to preserve the signature contrast of the world.
Do use 1px and 1.5px olive-tinted rules (#596051, #7D8076, #384534) to divide schedule rows, stats strips, and tournament specifications.
Do keep font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums active on all prices, slot counts, scores, and timestamps.
donts: Don't nest bordered cards inside bordered cards beyond the single permitted exception (the two selectable session rows inside the dark right-hand booking console).
Don't add small uppercase kickers or eyebrows above <h1> or <h2> headings.
Don't animate layout-triggering properties (width, height, top, left); restrict transitions to transform, opacity, background-color, border-color, and color using cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
